Kristian Aagaard Poulsen is a consultant physician (*overlæge*) affiliated with the Danish Surgical Society (*Dansk Kirurgisk Selskab*) and Odense University Hospital in the Region of Southern Denmark [^src1]. He serves as a member of the [[akut-kirurgi-databasen-styregruppe]], the governing body for the Acute Surgery Database (*Akut Kirurgi Databasen*, or AKDB) [^src1]. In this capacity, he provides surgical professional leadership and ensures the clinical relevance of the database's development and indicator frameworks [^src1].

His involvement is documented in the 2023 annual report for the AKDB, which operates under the Danish Regions' Clinical Quality Development Programme (RKKP) [^src1]. The steering group, of which he is a part, represents an interdisciplinary and cross-regional governance structure responsible for overseeing the database's clinical indicators and addressing operational frameworks across Denmark's five regions [^src1].
